cover.title: Welcome to Maple Cottage
cover.welcome:
We're so glad you're here. This book has everything you need for your stay: how things work, our favorite spots in town, and who to call if anything comes up.

Make yourself at home!

arrival.entry: Door code sent by message the morning you arrive
arrival.parking: Driveway, one car. Street parking is free after 6 PM.
arrival.trash: Bins beside the garage. Recycling is the blue bin. Pickup is Tuesday morning.

guide.name: Heat & air
guide.how: Thermostat is in the hallway. Please keep it between 66 and 76°F, and turn it down when you head out for the day.

guide.name: TV
guide.how: Use the black remote. Press Home to sign in to your own streaming accounts. Please sign out before you leave.

guide.name: Coffee
guide.how: Drip coffee maker on the counter. Filters and ground coffee are in the cabinet above it.

guide.name: Washer & dryer
guide.how: In the closet off the kitchen. Detergent is on the shelf. Clean the dryer lint screen after each load.

guide.name: Fireplace
guide.how: Gas fireplace. Flip the switch on the wall to the right. It turns off on its own after 2 hours.

rules: 10 PM to 8 AM. Our neighbors are close.
Not allowed inside or on the porch.
Please leave them by the door.

local.name: Harbor Bakery
local.note: Get the cherry scone. Opens at 7.

local.name: Point Beach
local.note: Best at sunset. Beach towels are in the hall closet.

local.name: The Net Shed
local.note: Fish tacos. Busy on weekends, so go early.

checkout: Put used towels in the bathtub
Take trash to the bins by the garage
Lock the door. The code resets after you leave.

emergency.where: First aid kit under the kitchen sink. Fire extinguisher by the back door. Water shutoff in the basement, left of the stairs.
